findings.title: Common Chinese and English negations are treated as affirmative deletion
findings.description: Don’t and shouldn't are not recognized as negation. 别删去 also fails: the 别 lookahead requires the deletion verb, but analyse searches only the substring before that verb. The otherwise identical Don't / do not / should not / 不要 / 无需 controls pass. Normalization and copy add a definite 149-word warning although the advice deletes nothing.

findings.title: Single-quoted wording and quoted rejected advice are treated as whole-unit deletion
findings.description: Only double quotation marks are masked. A two-word deletion in single quotes selects the later sentence noun, counts 23 words and reports 149 rather than the actual 170. Single-quoted advice being rejected also triggers deletion; the double-quoted controls do not.

limits: This is a targeted intent/scope check, not exhaustive natural-language coverage or semantic grading.
The expected removal is specified from the literal instruction; helper diagnostics are not the oracle.
All product findings go through normalize_evaluation and production evaluation_text. The probes do not render a browser or replace a full suite.
The Chinese single-quote short edit checks absence of a false warning, not successful recognition of that edit.
